name: Chalk user-facing job and webhook failures
description: The message names the Tenant from the database and counts affected Recordings or exhausted deliveries. Test Tenants remain visible, not silently suppressed.
aplQuery: ['${LOG_DATASET}'] | where chalk_alert_stream == 'production-state-v2' | summarize arg_max(_time, chalk_alert_value, chalk_alert_headline, chalk_alert_summary, chalk_alert_next, chalk_alert_engineers) by chalk_alert_rule, chalk_alert_tenant | summarize value=max(chalk_alert_value) by tenant=chalk_alert_tenant, rule=chalk_alert_rule, headline=chalk_alert_headline, summary=chalk_alert_summary, next=chalk_alert_next, engineers=chalk_alert_engineers

name: Chalk API requests or Sync connections are failing
description: Joining, loading, Recording or class connections may be failing right now. Normal leaves and server drains do not count.
aplQuery: ['${LOG_DATASET}'] | union ['${TRACE_DATASET}'] | where (['service.name'] == 'chalk-api' and ['attributes.event'] == 'http.request' and ['attributes.status'] >= 500) or (['service.name'] == 'chalk-sync' and (name == 'sync.http.upgrade_rejected' or (name == 'sync.websocket.closed' and ['attributes.close_kind'] == 'abnormal'))) | extend rule=iff(['service.name'] == 'chalk-sync', 'sync', 'api') | extend weight=iff(rule == 'sync', 3, 2), headline=iff(rule == 'sync', 'People are being disconnected from classes or cannot connect right now', 'Chalk is returning errors to people in class'), summary=iff(rule == 'sync', 'More than ten failed connections or abnormal drops occurred in five minutes. Normal leaves and server drains are excluded. Tenant attribution is not available for these events.', 'More than fifteen server errors occurred in five minutes. Joining, loading or starting a Recording may be failing right now. Tenant attribution is not available for these events.'), next='An engineer must investigate now; customers may need to reconnect after the cause is fixed.', engineers=strcat('For engineers: ', rule, '; `pnpm diag trace <32-hex-trace-id>` from an affected response or connection.') | summarize value=sum(weight) by rule, headline, summary, next, engineers

name: Chalk production alert state is stale
description: Chalk may be working, but nobody would be told about a job or webhook failure until this is fixed.
aplQuery: ['${LOG_DATASET}'] | where chalk_alert_stream == 'production-state-v2' and chalk_alert_rule in ('recording', 'export', 'transcript', 'webhook') | summarize value=dcount(chalk_alert_rule)
